notes.title: v1.06 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*]End music now plays for SHIFT 4
[*]Crashing SHIFT 4 is now much harder; if you crash it, it's your fault now
[*]A few additional very minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: SHIFT Legacy Collection Releasing August 7th!
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

We're happy to announce that SHIFT Legacy Collection will be releasing on [b]August 7th[/b] right here on Steam!  You'll be able to play all 4 original games + 5 players packs and the SHIFT 2 mini adventure!

Will you escape?

SHIFT Happens,
- The Armor Games Crew
